title: Financial Services Access and Routing
summary: Feedback about financial services centers on app access and locating the financial section, with examples split between helpful support routing, a findability complaint, and contact requests that do not state an outcome.

positive.summary: The positive review describes support that guided the customer through an app reinstall and transferred them to Financial Services for further help.

negative.summary: The negative review says the Financial section is very difficult to locate in the app.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined reviews mention being connected to or seeking the financial department and asking how to access financial services in the app, but they do not state whether the experience was good or bad.

limitations: The sample is very small, and several examples only describe contact or routing without an evaluative outcome.
The topic is narrow but lightly evidenced, so there is not enough detail to assess broader financial services performance beyond access and routing mentions.
